trust_decision.summary: An untrusted listObjects nodeId string is trusted as SQL text: IdentifierManager.querySystemMetadata concatenates nodeId.getValue().trim() into the WHERE clause while every other filter is bound with setString/setTimestamp; the CN listObjects route takes nodeId directly from the query string, and listObjects is not session-gated.

landing_point.why: This is the only request-reachable SQL in the DataONE listing path that concatenates a quoted string literal. A grep for the "'" + concatenation lands here directly.

fix_sites.module_kind: data-access helper (core, shared by CN/MN listObjects and SyncAccessPolicy)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MN listObjects and v1 CN listObjects only pass the configured dataone.nodeId (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/MNodeService.java:1277-1283, src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/v1/CNodeService.java:318-329), so a solver can argue the sink is only attacker-reachable through the v2 CN handler. Quota instanceId is server-side, post-auth state.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: replicaStatus=false listing filters on authoritive_member_node using the configured node id (for example urn:node:XYZ, which contains colons), and the whitespace-guid filter appends literal SQL. A fix that rejects or strips characters from nodeId, or one that rebuilds the clause without keeping the positional bind indexes aligned with the 16-branch f1..f4 ladder, breaks legitimate filtered listing.

O6_input_shapes: single string query parameter nodeId (only values[0] used), URL-decoded by EncodingUtilities.decodeString (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/restservice/v2/CNResourceHandler.java:1293-1297)
same value is spliced into both the paged field query and the count query (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/IdentifierManager.java:1540-1546)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Quota usage lookup concatenates instanceId (portal/series id) into a quoted literal in a prepared-statement string
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Reached only from BookKeeperClient during an authenticated quota/portal operation (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/quota/BookKeeperClient.java:395), so a solver can argue it is not part of an unauthenticated listing advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (dataone.quota) and different table from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: formatId filter written as a concatenated literal like the nodeId one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The adjacent nodeId branch at 1506-1515 already uses this style. The 16-branch bind ladder at 1548-1644 is exactly why a maintainer would avoid adding a bind index.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getLogRecords event or principal filter concatenated rather than bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same string-built WHERE pattern is used, and the create-event special case already juggles extra placeholders by hand (563-569).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: paged-query LIMIT/OFFSET taking a string count/start from the request
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The adapter concatenates start and count into SQL. They are Integer today, but this is an ORDER BY/LIMIT-position sibling living in a separate package (dbadapter).

O9_family: SQL injection (string-concatenated WHERE literal in a JDBC prepared statement)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven (root pom.xml plus metacat-common, metacat-index modules)
services: Solr/RabbitMQ for indexing paths (not needed for listObjects)
O10_build.project_tests: test/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacattest/IdentifierManagerIT.java, test/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/MNodeServiceIT.java, test/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/CNodeAccessControlTest.java (integration tests that need a configured database)

j.j_sites_touched: unknown (fix diff empty); confirmed vulnerable site src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/IdentifierManager.java
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape single quotes in nodeId, or reject non-[A-Za-z0-9:] node ids in the CN handler, instead of binding it as a fifth parameter in querySystemMetadata.

out_of_scope_notes: AuthFile builds XPath expressions by concatenating user/group names (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/authentication/AuthFile.java:218); this is XPath, not SQL, and was not pursued.
MNodeService builds Solr query strings with a quoted pid (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/dataone/MNodeService.java:2647, 2722); this is Solr query injection, a different sink, and was not pursued.
unverified: The provided fix diff (fix.diff:1-4) contains only a merge-commit header with no hunks, so the published fix's actual sites, files and tests could not be read. The candidate metadata claims 16 sites across 6 files with setString as the repeated check; only the IdentifierManager nodeId site was confirmed by reading the pinned code.
O1, O2, O4 and fix_sites therefore reflect the pinned-code analysis, not the published fix. The other 5 changed files are unknown and may include QuotaDBManager or DBUtil.
CWE-287 component: whether listObjects is meant to require authentication on CN, or whether the fix also added an auth check, could not be determined without the diff.
DBUtil.getCurrentRevisionAndDocTypeForGivenDocument concatenates docid (src/edu/ucsb/nceas/metacat/DBUtil.java:762), but a grep found no callers in src/, so it was not counted as a route.
